description: This Java class is a Spring MVC controller managing customer option sets in an admin interface, handling CRUD operations, pagination, and UI menu setup for customer options and their associations.

classes.name: CustomerOptionsSetController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing customer option sets, providing endpoints for listing, saving, deleting, paginating, and updating customer options and their associations.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the customer options set page, loading options and their values, and setting up the menu.

methods.name: saveOptionSet
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save a new customer option set, validating associations and avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: pageOptionsSet
methods.description: Handles POST requests to provide paginated data of customer option sets in JSON format for frontend display.

methods.name: deleteOptionSet
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a customer option set by ID, with authorization checks.

methods.name: updateOrder
methods.description: Handles POST requests to update the sort order of a customer option set.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up the menu and active state for the UI.
